name: Mall Shopfront Door
summary: Glazed double shopfront door with fixed aluminium frame, editable hinge roots and paired stainless pull handles.
description: Original generic 2.10 m by 2.40 m double-door module for Singapore/Malaysia mall scenes. Independent named leaves and materials. A door module only, not a roller shutter or a complete store.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled materials; no third-party models, artwork, textures or fonts.

assembly.instructions: Place the root at the floor plane of a 2.10 m x 2.40 m facade opening. Keep FRAME_Fixed stationary. Rotate HINGE_Left -90 degrees and HINGE_Right +90 degrees around Blender local Z / glTF local Y to open outward. Children retain local transforms. This is editable articulation, not an installed or certified door system.

material_notes: 33 independent closed meshes and four editable materials. Fixed frame and four hinge barrels; each leaf has separate rails, 10 mm transparent glass, frosted visibility bands, front/rear pull handles and brackets. Glass uses alpha 0.22 blending, not physically refractive glass. No exported animation clips or lights.
accuracy_notes: Generic visual concept, not a security, fire, accessibility, structural or building-code specification. Static gallery viewing only; no runtime click-to-open controls or door animation player. Frame aperture is 1.94 m; open clear width including handles is about 1.734 m.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local artifact and visual approval PASS; actual studio/gallery pixels and transparent/opaque/hidden glass controls inspected. Overall NEEDS REVIEW because physical Android/iOS remain untested. No runtime door interaction is claimed.
